description: This file implements a Smarty CacheResource class that uses APC as the caching backend. It provides methods to read, write, delete, and purge cache entries via APC functions, extending a key-value store cache resource.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Apc
classes.description: A cache resource class for Smarty that uses APC for storage, implementing methods to read, write, delete, and purge cached data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that checks if APC is installed, throws exception if not.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Fetches multiple cache entries by keys using APC's fetch function.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores multiple cache entries with optional expiration using APC's store function.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries by keys using APC's delete function.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Clears all user cache entries in APC.
